articles.headline: World Cup 2026 - updates, news as England prepare to face Ghana
articles.description: England will face Ghana on Tuesday in the World Cup after Senegal were left on the brink of elimination with Monday's loss to Norway.

articles.headline: Philipp Lahm: Gianni Infantino has 'sold out' the World Cup
articles.description: World Cup winner Philipp Lahm has launched a scathing criticism of FIFA president Gianni Infantino, accusing him of having "sold out" the World Cup.

articles.headline: Kylian Mbappé not thinking about World Cup Golden Boot race with Lionel Messi
articles.description: Kylian Mbappé has said he is not thinking about the World Cup Golden Boot race after he scored twice in France's 3-0 win over Iraq on Monday to take his goal tally for the tournament to four.
